scope: Rewrote the Japanese article and twelve translations against current PaperMod Features/Variables documentation, Hugo Page Bundle documentation, and X's developer-community notice about Card Validator previews. Compared meaning, theme variables, shared configuration snippets, image-path semantics, card-size claims, preview guidance, links, publication dates, and locale metadata.
findings: Corrected a Japanese typo and removed duplicated conflicting future dates while preserving the original 2022-09-10 publication date; added the actual 2026-11-24 lastmod date.
Added the production environment setting required by PaperMod's enhanced SEO metadata.
Clarified site fallback images, per-page cover images, Page Bundle relative paths, and cover.hidden behavior using the theme's documentation.
Removed the overgeneralized summary_large_image-only and fixed 800x418 claims; presented 1200x630 only as a practical wide-image design target.
Replaced the obsolete Validator-preview workflow with inspection of rendered metadata and X's post-composer preview; noted cache delay and no posting requirement.
Replaced stale references with current PaperMod, Hugo, and X developer sources; aligned all twelve translations and code examples to the Japanese source.
